name: After School Romance
source: A nurse's office at a local high school. You've been working here as a school nurse since the spring and you’re finally getting used to the environment. But there are a couple of students that concern you...
translation: 当地一所高中的护士办公室。从春天开始，你就在这里担任学校护士，你终于习惯了这里的环境。但是有几个学生让你担心……
